topic.readerProblem: A buyer who is unhappy with, or wary of, Peec AI wants a short list of real alternatives with current entry prices, the catch of each, and an honest view of when Peec AI is still the right pick.
topic.connection: AEOeye sells one-time AI visibility audits, not tracking; the page lists AEOeye honestly beside dedicated trackers and recommends them where ongoing monitoring is the actual need.

assessment: The page builds its reasons for leaving Peec AI only from Peec's own pricing page, API docs and terms, and drops the earlier version's unsupported ones ('only diagnoses', 30-50% hidden cost, 'three engines plus Gemini/Claude add-ons') after finding Peec's Actions documentation and current model lists. Each alternative's entry price, engines and limits were read from that vendor's own rendered pricing page on 2026-10-03 (Otterly.AI, AthenaHQ, Profound, Nightwatch), and per-prompt and per-response figures are our own arithmetic, labelled as such. It uses one first-hand AEOeye fact (0 of 43 AI-visibility vendor sites block an AI retrieval bot in the crawler access study). It deliberately does not rate product quality, claim hands-on testing, convert currencies, or state Nightwatch's monthly-billing price, which was not re-read today.

sources.supports: Rendered in a browser: $95/$245/$495 a month monthly and $80/$205/$420 annual; 50/150/350 prompts; choose 3 models; model list; Enterprise column with Claude Sonnet 4 and others; extra-model add-on $30/$70/$140 labelled Annual; gap analysis and recommended actions listed.
Agency plans $245, $495, $795 a month (monthly) and free pitch projects for auditing prospects.
Monthly subscription ends at the end of the payment cycle; no automatic refund for early termination of a fixed term (10.5).
API access currently limited to Enterprise customers.
Actions: ranked list of recommendations grouped into Site audit, Owned and Earned, with evidence and a brief.
Prompts are conversational questions that Peec runs across AI platforms; used for the prompt definition.

Rendered in a browser: Lite $29 / 15 prompts, Standard $189 / 100, Premium $489 / 400; four engines (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, MS Copilot), Claude, Google AI Mode and Gemini as add-ons (Lite monthly: $29, $9, $9); unlimited team members; daily tracking; free trial with no length stated; monthly subscriptions.
Essential free ($25 free credit, 300 credits, five engines); Starter $295/month, 3,600 credits, 11 models, 1 credit = 1 AI response; API and extra credits paid add-ons with no published price.
Free Trial: 50 prompts run daily for 7 days on ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overviews; Enterprise custom, up to 9 answer engines, SSO/SAML and SOC 2; no self-serve paid price.

Yearly toggle: Starter EUR 79 a month (EUR 948 billed yearly), 500 keywords, 50 AI prompts; Professional EUR 159, 150 prompts; Agency EUR 399, 500 prompts; 14-day trial, no card; AI platforms ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Mode, AI Overview on every plan.
